Gunmaggedon experimental build
Runtime helper: 1.8.1
Blueprinter asset pack: 0.0.16

With Nuclear Option closed, copy BepInEx into the game's BepInEx directory.
Back up your installation/config first. Keep only the current .nobp active.
Both helper DLL and asset pack are required. Restart the game to load them.
Requires your own working BepInEx/Blueprinter installation and game assemblies.

Includes coastal HE/AP and special ammunition, L40 optical AA/recoil/handles/
sound/casings, and coordinated night searchlights with two-sided cones and
very large on-axis lens glare. Custom mission hitch/unhitch is disabled.

Nine standalone suites and the documented Unity searchlight/render fixtures
passed. Startup passed with this helper and pack. Mission balance, multiplayer
presentation and GPU performance remain unverified. See repository context/.
Verify the two installed binaries against SHA256SUMS.txt.
